title: Kittim
description: Son (people) of Javan (Gen 10:4; KJV "Kittim"). Josephus (Antiquities I.6.1, Whiston): "Cethimus possessed the island Cethima: it is now called Cyprus" Genesis lists this name with a plural or gentilic form (a people/clan); it is kept as a person record so the family tree links up.

sorting_basis.note: No tier 1-4 dates this record's birth; unsorted (null).

birth.note: pending CFAH reference. CFAH dates the Table-of-Nations framework (first territorial division AP-27, 2254 BC; final division AP-28, 2247 BC; Dispersion AP-2, 2192/2191 BC) but not this individual birth
Jones gives no birth year for Table-of-Nations names.
Ussher (Annals) gives no birth year for this name.

birth.citation: Jordan, "The Chronology of the Pentateuch (Part 3)," Biblical Chronology 6:5 (May 1994), §8 "The Table of Nations", table "An Hypothetical Chronology for the Table of Nations"
birth.note: Jordan: "If we assume births every two years, and about 30 years between generations ... we can come up with an approximate series of dates" (hypothetical, not stated by Scripture).

open_questions: Place link is by name: OpenBible identifies the place named in later scripture (Dan.11.30, Num.24.24), not the Gen 10 ancestor. Certainty: land-of-kittim very-high.
